import os
import json
import stat

def _native_staging_target(src: Path, dst: Path) -> bool:
    """Validate owned run copies before copytree/copy2 can follow any alias."""
    if os.environ.get("NSTACK_NATIVE_BRIDGE") != "1":
        return False
    roots = [Path(value) for value in json.loads(os.environ["NSTACK_NATIVE_STAGING_ROOTS"])]
    if not roots or any(not value.is_absolute() or value.resolve() != value
                        or value.stat().st_uid != os.getuid()
                        or value.stat().st_mode & 0o077 for value in roots):
        raise ValueError("Native staging roots must be owned private run directories")
    destination = dst.absolute()
    source = src.absolute()
    if (source.resolve() != source or destination.resolve() != destination
            or not any(destination != value and destination.is_relative_to(value) for value in roots)
            or destination.is_relative_to(source) or source.is_relative_to(destination)):
        raise ValueError("Native staging destination is outside the owned run scope")
    # Reject source and existing destination aliases BEFORE the original copy.
    # rglob does not recurse through symlink directories; lstat never follows one.
    for tree in (source, destination):
        if not tree.exists() and not tree.is_symlink():
            continue
        paths = [tree, *tree.rglob("*")] if tree.is_dir() and not tree.is_symlink() else [tree]
        for path in paths:
            metadata = path.lstat()
            if (stat.S_ISLNK(metadata.st_mode)
                    or not (stat.S_ISDIR(metadata.st_mode) or stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode))
                    or (tree == destination and metadata.st_uid != os.getuid())):
                raise ValueError("Unsafe native staging source/destination alias or owner")
    return True
